text.en:
Recruitment of Amateurs. No amateur player shall be recruited into the professional ranks and
no professional shall be given or reverted to amateur status without the recommendation of the national sports
association concerned and prior approval of the Department of Youth and Sports Development (DYSD). For
this purpose, the national sports association, considering its particular requirements, shall promulgate the
pertinent guidelines and applicable rules and regulations governing the change of status, and formulate such
incentive schemes to encourage amateurism, subject to the approval of DYSD.

National Pool of Athletes. The accredited national sports association shall maintain, through the
supervision and support of the National Youth and Sports Development Foundation created under Presidential
Decree No. 1289 dated January 25, 1978, a national pool of athletes for each sport, as may be recommended
by the National Sports Association and approved by DYSD, to effect a coordinated and continuing program of
training and development of the maximum potential of athletes cognizant of international performance
The National Sports Association concerned shall be principally responsible in the recruitment, selection and
training of athletes to compose the national pool from whose ranks shall be drawn the national representatives
in regional and international competitions, subject to the supervision of DYSD.

Separability Clause. If any provision of this Decree is declared unconstitutional, the same shall
apply only to the provision and the remainder hereof remains valid.

Repealing Clause. All laws, decrees, executive orders, rules and regulations which are
inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the Year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
